name: host-preview-app
goal: Host vào preview riêng, không lockdown và không ghi bài làm.
design_constraints: Host preview is an authenticated HOST_ADMIN route selected after server-backed session access; it must never use DEV_SKIP_AUTH, fake student identity, or student attempt APIs.
Host preview owns only RAM answers, local timer/navigation state, and isolated temporary recording files; no Drift answer/outbox, upload, scoring, quota, or attempt writes.
Gate native lockdown, violation retry, SyncEngine, and MediaUploadCoordinator by authenticated student context; preserve queued student data and restore normal enforcement after host logout.
Use the existing common templates/components and canonical task registry; do not treat the old dev preview as live behavior and do not alter student visual behavior.
Next is available on every preview item, Previous is preview-only, and Finish closes locally; item epoch invalidation and awaited media cleanup prevent stale callbacks.

repository_conventions: Flutter uses feature-first folders, BLoC/Cubit state, GetIt constructor injection, Material 3 common widgets, and explicit dispose/teardown.
Existing student attempt widgets remain persistence/security owners; preview gets separate repository, dispatcher, navigation, and media session.
Unit/widget tests use existing mock API/auth/security helpers and must assert no student-side write dependency is constructed.
boundaries: Only the exact app paths and preview tests in quang-execution-file-manifest.md may change in this phase.
Do not edit shared template/component files unless a new exact path is added to the manifest; do not change API, web, notification, migration, Docker, or unrelated dirty worktree paths.
applicable_rules: Keep role routing and server auth separate from UI-only JWT branching; recheck API success before content display.
Dispose timers, audio, recorder, temp files, and preview RAM on back/logout/401/error; student queues remain untouched.
Use common error/toast surfaces and avoid raw machine errors or release bypass flags.
allowed_exceptions: Quality gate is skipped by Quang and must remain skipped_by_user; unit/widget tests are required and owned by ck:test.

steps.description: Tách canPreviewExam(HOST_ADMIN) khỏi canTakeExam(STUDENT); AppAuthGate host ưu tiên preview sau backend auth, multi-role mặc định preview, role khác denied; không DEV_SKIP_AUTH hay fake student id.
success_criteria: Routing tests H1/S1/M1/X1 pass, host không vào student device-check hoặc attempt flow.

steps.description: Nối session lifecycle và queue ownership: host/unauthenticated không kích hoạt native enforcement hoặc flush queue student bằng host token; dispose retry khi đổi identity, không xóa student queue. Handoff §5, AU08/SC01–02.
success_criteria: Host login với seeded student queues: không gửi bằng host token, không xóa rows; student sau logout có normal scheduling.

steps.description: Tạo domain repository interface + API implementation + DTO adapter + DI feature; lazy resources scoped preview session. Không tham chiếu SyncEngine/outbox/attempt repository trong feature preview.
success_criteria: Repository HTTP spy chỉ gọi authorized read endpoints; feature dependency graph không inject attempt/outbox/upload coordinator.

steps.description: Host list dùng existing GET sessions; loading/empty/error, tên/mã/status/snapshot availability; chọn READY có snapshot, DRAFT disabled. Common controls, không thêm toggle login.
success_criteria: Widget list tests loading/empty/error/DRAFT/READY pass, action availability dựa snapshotPublicId chứ không status đơn lẻ.

steps.description: Chia pure renderer/response widgets cho preview và student; implement local text/select/multi/blank/reorder/token state. Dùng real templates; không chỉ render dev static response, không tạo dummy attempt.
success_criteria: Tests 7 response families thao tác có thay đổi RAM; cùng shared templates với student, không Drift writes.

steps.description: Implement Next/Previous/Finish local, epoch invalidation, double-click guard; timer expiry dừng response nhưng ở nguyên câu; local answers RAM key snapshot+item. Handoff §5 transition order, UI03–08.
success_criteria: UI03–08 tests pass: Next mọi dạng, epoch chặn callback cũ, không auto-next khi hết giờ, cuối đề chỉ đóng preview.

steps.description: Preview audio/recorder own temp dir và subscriptions; await stop trước next, finally delete, mic/media errors skippable; bounded URL refresh, snapshot mismatch resets; crash sweep không đụng student.
success_criteria: DA01–02/AP08–09/UI04–05/UI09 pass: stop/delete trước rời item, bounded refresh, crash sweep chỉ preview-owned files.

steps.description: Logout/401/back/native close dispose media/timers/RAM, rồi reset context; host->student phục hồi enforcement theo role/attempt. Không mutate session.policy.lockdownMode.
success_criteria: AU02/AU07/SC01–02 pass: resources disposed khi logout/401, student enforcement trở lại không dùng dart-define.

steps.description: Test routing, queues, lifecycle, no-persistence spies và 22 distinct renderers; extra personal introduction nếu snapshot có. Run analyze + focused/full Flutter tests, ghi ca chưa chạy.
success_criteria: Coverage report liệt kê 22 distinct canonical codes, Flutter analyze/tests exit 0 hoặc ghi rõ failure/skip.
